prompt: Create a new magic item page from scratch for Tideglass Compass — an uncommon wondrous item that points toward the nearest safe berth the bearer has previously docked at, but fogs when Crown warships are within a day's sail. Mark all of this as invention; it is not in the campaign wiki. Use wiki/templates/item.md. Show a chat proposal / work gate before writing under wiki/.
expected_output: A new item page labeled invention:true that follows item.md, with pitch before mechanics, narration without secrets, classification, and one runnable 2024 effect with costs/limits. No claim that Tideglass Compass exists in vault canon.

assertions.text: Frontmatter includes type: item, kind, rarity, attunement, and required identity fields (lifecycle, reveal, campaign, visibility, summary)
Invention is labeled with invention: true or clearly marked as proposed, not presented as vault canon
Pitch / Signature sentence appears before the page draft
Shows a chat proposal / work gate before writing under wiki/
Narration is a cold portrait without secrets, DCs, or unearned names
Runnable effect specifies trigger, action cost, frequency/limits, and counterplay or failure mode — not an unbounded always-on oracle
